summary: QQQM gives low-cost access to the Nasdaq-100 — the growth/tech engine of US large caps — at 0.15%, the buy-and-hold version of QQQ. Higher long-run growth, but tech concentration and a richer valuation lower its DCA score versus the broad/value funds. A strong growth satellite rather than the core.
